item.title: Applied Scientist, Engineering - Anthropic
item.description:
**About Anthropic** -------------------
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
**About the role** ------------------
The Discovery team at Anthropic is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long-term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier.
We're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely.
We're seeking exceptional researchers with deep expertise in one or more of these areas. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of frontier AI and your field, developing rigorous methods to measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and to test Claude's designs against real-world feedback.
**Key responsibilities** ------------------------
* Design and implement evaluation methodologies for assessing AI model capabilities relevant to engineering and applied science research and applications * Design realistic tasks and training environments, and curate data from your field * Develop and validate simulations and computational tools for your field, and calibrate them against real-world data * Work with industry partners, manufacturers, and labs to build and test what Claude invents, designs, and engineers, and bring that real-world feedback into evaluation and training * Think through how Claude's engineering capabilities can permeate the real world: where they can have the most impact across industry and research, and what it takes to get them adopted * Advise the team on which problems, tools, and workflows matter most in your field * Collaborate with domain experts and partners to establish benchmarks and gather high-quality data for training * Translate between engineering domain knowledge and machine learning objectives
**Minimum qualifications** --------------------------
* Deep expertise and hands-on R&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, structural, industrial, or manufacturing engineering; applied physics; computational simulation * Experience with AI or machine learning, whether evaluating and training AI systems or applying these tools in your field * Track record of taking work from concept through to a working result, such as a product, process, device, experiment, or tool * Hands-on proficiency with the computational design, analysis, or simulation tools used in your field * Basic programming proficiency, for example in Python * Ability to navigate ambiguity and develop solutions in a rapidly evolving research environment * Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and to explain your field clearly to people outside it * Commitment to using AI to accelerate engineering and scientific progress while maintaining high ethical standards
**Preferred qualifications** ----------------------------
* 5+ years of hands-on R&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline * Ph.D. in an engineering or applied science field, or equivalent industry experience * Industry experience in product design and manufacturing, or in developing engineering or scientific simulation software * Breadth across more than one discipline, or across several stages of the path from design to production * Familiarity with modern AI model training methods * Track record of building high-fidelity solvers or simulation engines that were validated against real-world data and used in practice * Experience working with manufacturers, vendors, contract research organizations, or academic labs * Experience managing data pipelines and working with large-scale technical datasets * Publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific or engineering software
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary:
$320,000 - $405,000 USD
**Logistics** -------------
**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
**How we're different** -----------------------
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Int

item.title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement - OpenAI
item.description:
Data Science - San Francisco
**About the team** ------------------
The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.
**About the role** ------------------
We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.
**In this role, you will** --------------------------
* Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenueance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail. * Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation. * Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions. * Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations. * Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans. * Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort. * Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.
**You might thrive in this role if you** ----------------------------------------
* Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products. * Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data. * Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled. * Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution. * Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners. * Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.
**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable lawation technology systems and related data security obligations.
To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities.
At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
**Compensation**
$347K – $385K + Offers Equity
The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factorsance-related bonus(es) for eligible employees, and the following benefits.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, with employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts * Pre-tax accounts for Health FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and commuter expenses (parking and transit) * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match * Paid parental leave (up to 24 weeks for birth parents and 20 weeks for non-birthing parents), plus paid medical and caregiver leave (up to 8 weeks) * Paid time off: flexible PTO for exempt employees and up to 15 days annually for non-exempt employees * 13+ paid company holidays, and multiple paid coordinated company office closures throughout the year for focus and recharge, plus paid sick or safe time (1 hour per 30 hours worked, or more, as required by applicable state or local law) * Mental health and wellness support * Employer-paid basic life and disability coverage * Annual learning and development stipend to fuel your professional growth * Daily meals in our offices, and meal delivery credits as eligible * Relocation support for eligible employees * Additional taxable fringe benefits, such as charitable donation matching and wellness stipends, may also be provided.
More details about our benefits are available to candidates during the hiring process.
This role is at-will and OpenAI reserves the right to modify base pay and other compensation components at any time based on individual performance, team or company results, or market conditions.

item.title: AIML - Sr Data Scientist, Evaluation - Apple
item.description:
Summary
Do you get excited by driving product impact via measurement and evaluation, for products and services used by hundreds of millions of people globally? Within the evaluation organization, the mission of Data Science and Insights team is to guide product development, decisions and directions through principled evaluation and rigorous use of data. You will partner with various engineering teams to improve search quality and guide feature development with data, to deliver amazing search experiences across iPhone, iPad, HomePod, Mac, Watch, tv, across dozens of languages.
Description
Research and develop evaluation methods to improve the quality of Apple user facing products, such as Siri and Apple Intelligence. Work with evaluation/experimentation engineering teams to get your methodological developments translated into technologies that product engineering will use every day. Work with large, complex data sets. Solve difficult, non-routine analysis problems, applying advanced analytical methods as needed, including prompt engineering and building LLMs as judges. Conduct analysis that includes data collection and quality control, requirements specification, processing and presentations. Build and prototype analysis pipelines iteratively to provide insights at scale. Develop comprehensive knowledge of product data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed for product development. Partner closely with product engineering teams on core machine learning algorithms and user experience evaluations. You should be passionate about building outstanding products. This position involves a wide variety of skills and innovation.
Minimum Qualifications
* Advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Operational Research, Bioinformatics, Economics, Psychology, Computer Science, Sociology, Mathematics, Physics, or similar quantitative field. * Proficiency in data science, machine learning, and analytics, including statistical data analysis. Experience crafting, conducting, analyzing, and interpreting experiments and investigations, especially on data quality, evaluation and risk assessment. * Strong programming skills, including data-querying skills (SQL and/or Spark, etc.) and experience with a scripting language for data processing and development (e.g., Python, R, or Scala). * Experience articulating and translating business questions and using statistical techniques to arrive at an answer using available data. Strong communication skills and the ability to naturally explain difficult technical topics (especially causal topics) to everyone from data scientists to engineers to business partners.
Preferred Qualifications
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across functions and work well within a team. * Capable of driving projects of varying sizes and scopes - some will take months and some weeks — and you will need to know when to dive deep. * Worked with methods that address accuracy and variability in human annotation data. * Ability to learn new technology and skills to accommodate changing working requirements.
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.
Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant

item.title: AIML - Data Scientist, Evaluation - Apple
item.description:
Summary
Do you get excited by building software systems to enhance the automatic evaluation of various Apple AI products? Our Evaluation organization is responsible for providing principled assessments across a diverse range of Apple features, from Search, Siri to the latest Apple Intelligence capabilities. As part of our online metrics and insights team, we are looking for a Sr Data Scientist to contribute to product understanding and development of Apple features. This role involves using analytical and engineering methods augmented by LLMs and python to develop conceptual and analytical models and perform insights analyses to uncover product quality issues that can inform improving the overall user experience.
Description
As a Sr Data Scientist, you will use statistical and LLM analysis of structured and linguistic data to deepen our understanding of Apple’s AI product and support the development of future versions. Investigate world-wide product usage to identify weaknesses and chances to create the product better. Define metrics and instrumentation strategies to assess the success of new features. Build relationships with Engineering leads and product partners to drive a privacy-first strategy for analytical insight. Employ a diverse toolkit of detailed analytical approaches, methodologies, frameworks, and technical strategies with a particular focus on language data analysis. Build credibility with partners through clarity and structured, critical thinking.
Minimum Qualifications
* 3+ years of data science experience applying quantitative methods to structured and unstructured data for exploratory data analysis, pattern recognition, metrics development, and analytical insights. * Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience in data manipulation, processing, and analytics pipelines. * Experience with LLM-driven analytics workflows, using Python coding frameworks and evaluation pipelines. * Proven ability to analyze user behavior, design and interpret A/B experiments, and translate findings into product improvements. * Master degree in a technical or quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Linguistics, or Physics (PhD preferred).
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) and LLMs. * Experience with development of dataset and analysis conceptual methodologies. * Self-motivated and curious with demonstrated creative and critical thinking capabilities and a highly developed drive to determine and improve how things work. * Excellent communication skills—able to synthesize analyses into clear insights and influence multi-functional partners. * High tolerance for ambiguity. You find a way through. You anticipate. You connect and synthesize. * Demonstrated experience in encouraging partner relationships and influencing decisions with data.

item.title: ML - Data Scientist - Apple
item.description:
Summary
Do you want to decide whether a generative imaging feature is good enough to ship? Our team evaluates generative image and video features. These features reach a very large number of people on Apple devices. You will build the evaluation systems, human-annotation programs, and automated metrics that turn "this looks better" into measurable, trustworthy quality signals. Those signals guide model development and release decisions.
Description
You'll own quality evaluation end to end — from evaluation set design through annotation, scoring, analysis, and the recommendations that shape what engineering and product build next. Your findings determine which models ship. What you'll do Build the measurement foundation. Design and maintain golden sets and evaluation sets, analyzing data distributions so results stay representative and known defects stay covered. Run human evaluation at quality. Write and iterate annotation guidelines and label schemas, build or adapt lightweight labeling tools for image and video review, monitor annotator quality, and resolve disagreements and guideline ambiguity. Automate the repeatable parts. Develop automated metrics and LLM-as-judge systems, calibrate them against human labels, and track where they diverge. Make the results decision-ready. Report model-vs-model comparisons with confidence intervals, significance testing, and breakdowns by hotspot, content type, and failure mode — then turn them into root-cause findings and prioritized recommendations. Set the bar with your partners. Work with ML, engineering, and design to define quality standards, and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
Minimum Qualifications
* MS and a minimum of 5 years relevant industry experience * 5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning evaluation, algorithm analysis, or related technical disciplines. * Experience designing and analyzing evaluations and experiments, especially for ML or generative model quality. This includes sampling design, significance testing, and confidence intervals. * Strong Python skills and comfort with SQL, with the ability to build and maintain evaluation pipelines and small tools. * Familiarity with AI-assisted analysis workflows, foundation models, agentic systems, or intelligent automation approaches for technical problem solving.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience evaluating 3D Gaussian splats or diffusion models, or assessing perceptual quality. * Experience building LLM or VLM judges and validating them against human ratings. * Experience building web-based labeling or review tools. * Ability to run several work-streams in parallel and prioritize them. * Proven cross-functional collaboration and the ability to learn new tools quickly. * Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining statistical tradeoffs to engineers and product partners.
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

item.title: Sr Applied Scientist - Uber
item.description:
**About the role**
The Policy Economics team conducts external research that forms the foundation for Uber’s policy positions and helps policymakers, thought leaders, and the general public gain a better understanding of our platform. We also conduct internal research that supports strategic decisions, helping leadership to weigh complex trade-offs across competitive, legal, operational, and product considerations.
Serving as a bridge between policy experts and technical teams, we help the policy team deliver principled advice to product teams and arming policy leads with an understanding of the economics of Uber’s marketplace. Our work spans the full spectrum — from internal analytical deep dives, to rapid-response analyses on high-profile policy issues, to multi-year research collaborations with external partners that build public understanding of the platform economy.
**Responsibilities**
* Conduct rigorous, careful statistical and econometric analysis in service of our policy priorities, particularly on topics relating to drivers and couriers, marketplace dynamics, and core technology such as matching and pricing. * Partner with in-country policy teams to develop research that speaks to their local contexts. * Develop deep cross-functional relationships with product, legal, and operations to ensure alignment between policy and business strategy. * Manage relationships with our external research partners to ensure research collaborations run smoothly.
**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Economics or another quantitative field. Candidates with a relevant PhD and/or extensive experience will be evaluated (and compensated) commensurate with their education and experience. * 5+ years of professional industry experience as an Applied Scientist, Data Scientist, Economist, or equivalent (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.) * Strong data skills and experience with tools such as SQL, Python, and R to work efficiently at scale. * Ability to work independently and execute a research plan with minimal oversight. * Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to synthesize research results into clear, actionable insights accessible to broad audiences.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* PhD in Economics. * Proficiency in Python. * Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with ability to collaborate cross-functionally and translate technical findings for non-technical audiences. * Ability to proactively identify research questions relevant to business or policy. * Project management skills and experience working in a cross-functional environment with legal, policy, and business leaders. * Passion for Uber’s mission and for helping shape fair, transparent narratives about drivers, couriers, customers, and marketplace dynamics.
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $190,000 per year - USD $211,000 per year.
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.
**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

item.title: Multimodal AI Applied Scientist, SIML - ISE - Apple
item.description:
Summary
Apple's System Intelligence and Machine Learning (SIML) team is seeking a Multimodal AI applied scientist to drive the future of multimodal scene understanding and human-centric device interaction. At the heart of this effort, you will develop multimodal LLMs designed to perceive complex environments and understand nuanced human behaviors, preferences, and interactions. This role offers a rare opportunity to join a leading applied research team known for its foundational contributions to Apple Intelligence, where you will work across the entire generative model lifecycle, spanning novel architecture design, model training, and deployment.
Description
We are looking for an applied scientist with deep skills in ML and generative modeling to architect, train, and deploy multimodal scene understanding technology that can understand scene from visual and audio data. You will quickly build and demonstrate new user experiences using large foundation models, developing innovative capabilities while partnering with cross-functional teams and iterating rapidly in a dynamic environment. Your work will advance human interaction and scene understanding modeling across the stack, from system-level architecture to core ML algorithms. Among the many challenges you will address are modeling user behaviors and preferences through device and environmental interactions, retrieving nuanced insights from historical context, handling deeply interleaved streaming data, reasoning across diverse temporal horizons, designing memory systems for long-term adaptation, and learning semantically rich representations for open-ended downstream applications. You will also be responsible for delivering ML models and solutions that can be readily integrated into production pipelines, such as APIs for production-ready models and algorithms built directly into our training infrastructure.
Minimum Qualifications
* PhD or MS Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with a focus on machine learning * Strong research skills with first author publications in top tier ML conferences * Expert-level knowledge of SOTA in large auto-regressive transformer models, multi-modal encoders, and representation learning. * Experience with multimodal large language models (LLMs) * Strong programming skills in Python, maintaining ML code bases grounded in software engineering principles.
Preferred Qualifications
* PhD in Machine Learning * Proven track record of deploying innovative ML technologies in production. * Familiarity with developing ML for resource-constrained devices. * Experience working with large cross-functional and diverse teams.

item.title: Learning Analytics Data Scientist, Employee Experience & Productivity, IS&T - Apple
item.description:
Summary
The difference between data and intelligence is context. This role enriches data with business context to produce insights that enable intelligent decisions. Join Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine powering Apple. As a member of the Employee Productivity & Support Data Science team, you will use data to improve how Apple trains its employees and delivers knowledge resources. You will pull and prepare data from multiple systems, build dashboards and visualizations, and conduct analyses that help learning and development leaders understand program effectiveness and make informed decisions. This role is about interpreting data, extracting insights, and partnering closely with the business to turn those insights into better decisions.
Description
In this role, you will support IS&T's Knowledge & Training group by building and maintaining the analytical assets it relies on — dashboards, reports, and ad-hoc analyses that surface how training programs and knowledge resources are performing across the organization. You will draw on your expertise in learning and development analytics to understand how employees engage with training content, identify where programs can improve, and develop metrics that measure effectiveness beyond attendance. A core part of the role is partnership: you will work directly with knowledge and training leaders to understand their challenges, translate them into analytical work, and deliver findings that are clear, accurate, and actionable. You are not building in isolation — you are a thought partner who understands the business well enough to know what to measure and why it matters. Day to day, you will write SQL to model data from large datasets, build and maintain Tableau dashboards, conduct analyses to identify trends and anomalies, and present your findings to stakeholders at various levels — all while using AI tools to accelerate your analytical work. The ideal candidate is someone who is technically strong, detail-oriented, and equally motivated by the work the data enables as by the data itself.
Minimum Qualifications
* 3+ years of experience working with learning and development data, including training platforms, content performance metrics, or learner engagement data. * 3+ years of hands-on experience writing SQL to extract, transform, and analyze data from large, multi-source datasets. * 3+ years of experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau, Looker, or equivalent. * 1+ years of experience in Python or R for data manipulation and analysis. * 3+ years of experience delivering analytical work in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and multiple concurrent stakeholders. * Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related quantitative field — or a Master's degree in a quantitative or business discipline with 2+ years of relevant experience.
Preferred Qualifications
* Working knowledge of how data informs content strategy, curriculum design, and self-service enablement. * Working knowledge of clickstream data and web analytics as applied to content performance and user engagement measurement. * Proficiency in version control and collaborative documentation practices using tools like GitHub. * Knowledge of statistical modeling, including hypothesis testing, regression, and foundational causal inference methods. * Track record of applying AI to real-world data analytics and general productivity challenges. * Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, adapting depth and format to the situation. * Comfort with ambiguity; ability to define the analytical approach when the business question is loosely framed. * Proven ability to build trust with leaders across diverse functional areas. * Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, data science, economics, operations research, applied mathematics, the natural sciences, or an MBA with analytics concentration)

item.title: Senior Data Scientist, Apple Ads - Apple
item.description:
Summary
At Apple, we focus deeply on our customers’ experience. Apple Ads brings this same approach to advertising, helping people find exactly what they’re looking for and helping advertisers grow their businesses. Our technology powers ads and sponsorships across Apple Services, including the App Store, Apple News, and MLS Season Pass. Everything we do is designed for trust, connection, and impact: We respect user privacy, integrate advertising thoughtfully into the experience, and deliver value for advertisers of all sizes, from small app developers to global brands. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone. The Data Insights organization helps Apple Ads understand, measure, forecast, optimize, and improve the advertising ecosystem across Apple Services. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, and Leadership teams to solve complex business and product challenges using data, experimentation, statistical modeling, and machine learning. We are hiring Data Scientists across multiple teams and areas of focus within Apple Ads. Successful candidates may be considered for a variety of opportunities depending on their experience, interests, and technical strengths. Our hiring process is designed to match candidates to the teams and problem spaces where they can have the greatest impact.
Description
As a Data Scientist within Data Insights, you will work on high-impact problems that influence product strategy, business performance, advertiser outcomes, and marketplace health across Apple's advertising platforms. Depending on your area of focus, you may contribute to one or more of the following domains: - Product and Marketplace Insights: Define measurement frameworks, design experiments, evaluate product and advertiser outcomes, and identify marketplace opportunities that influence product strategy and decision-making. - Business Insights: Own key business metrics, identify drivers of business performance, and translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations for leadership. Build scalable analytical frameworks and automation solutions that improve decision-making across the advertising ecosystem. - Predictive Modeling, Forecasting & Optimization: Develop forecasting, machine learning, and optimization models that improve business performance and operational decision-making. Design robust evaluation frameworks and translate model outputs into scalable business impact. - Advertiser GTM Research - Quantitative Research & Econometrics: Apply statistical, econometric, optimization, and causal inference techniques to better understand marketplace behavior, advertising effectiveness, and incrementality in support of strategic decision-making. We hire across multiple levels and specialties within the Data Insights organization. Candidates may be considered for different teams and opportunities based on experience, interests, and business needs. item.title: Data Scientist - Intelligent Experiences, MLO - Apple
item.description:
Summary
Do you believe machine learning and AI can change the world? We do. We're the ML Data team within Apple's Intelligent System Experience (ISE) group, and we build the high-quality, high-scale datasets that train the ML features across many Apple products — iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, AirPods and the newly released HomeView. Our work sits behind some of the most visible and personal experiences Apple ships: the wallpaper on your Lock Screen, personalized stickers in iMessage, on-device Genmoji and other Apple Intelligence generative models, and models that recognize faces and build memories of the people you love in Photos. We're looking for a data scientist who's passionate about ML data and excited to shape the training data behind Apple's next generation of multi-modal features. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings rigorous scientific reasoning and owns problems end-to-end. Join us and you’ll shape shipping products from your first week, working with petabytes of multi-modal data.
Description
You will design and operate the end-to-end data lifecycle that supports training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of large language models and diffusion models. Day to day, that means building distributed pipelines that clean, deduplicate, and enrich massive multi-modal datasets; standing up synthetic data generation pipelines with LLM-based generators, validators, and judges; and engineering agentic workflows — multi-step, tool-using LLM systems — that scale human judgment across far more data than a human team could review directly.
Minimum Qualifications
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related engineering field * 5+ years of hands-on experience applying NLP, computer vision, or multimodal machine learning to production systems, including experience with large-scale data pipelines
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience prompting, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs or vision-language/diffusion models for specific downstream tasks * Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), preference optimization (RLHF, DPO), RAG and retrieval-based data curation * Experience designing, evaluating and productionizing data science algorithms used for data curation, data filtering, deduplication and data down-selection. * Experience designing controlled experiments or ablation studies to understand effect of data on model quality * Experience building agentic or multi-agent, tool-using LLM systems and human-in-the-loop workflows, calibrating judges against human labels, and mitigating failure modes * Strong software engineering skills, with 5+ years in Python, workflow orchestration (Airflow), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Ray, or similar) at large scale * Publication record or open-source contributions in NLP, computer vision, or generative AI is a plus * Familiarity with privacy-preserving data techniques (e.g., differential privacy, on-device data constraints) is a plus

item.description:
Summary
Siri helps hundreds of millions of people find the information they are looking for. A critical part of that mission is helping them quickly find and discover local businesses, places of interest, and addresses. Users rely on us for relevant and easy access to local information like finding a favorite or romantic restaurant, business hours, nearby coffee shop addresses, and directions to prominent locations. The Geo domain team is redefining how hundreds of millions of people use their devices to navigate and explore the physical world around them. We are part of a wider effort to power search across a variety of Apple products – including Siri, Spotlight, Safari, Messages, and more. As part of our team, you will be using innovative machine learning techniques and LLMs in order to understand queries, rank documents, and find useful answers to users’ questions. We are looking for an experienced ML engineer with hands-on experience in search and recommendation and deploying powerful machine learning models at scale. You will join a team that combines strong technical skills, product vision, and a love of all things local to bring together the pieces needed to deliver an extraordinary Maps experience in Siri and Spotlight.

As a member of our fast-paced group, you’ll have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape upcoming products from Apple. Our team includes a diversity of backgrounds from applied scientists with a focus in NLP to experienced distributed systems. item.title: Staff Product Data Scientist, Merchant Shopping - Google
item.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * 10 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, performing statistical analysis, and coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL) or 8 years work experience with a Master's degree. * Experience with machine learning (ML), machine learning algorithms, artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms, coding, system design, or software development.
### **Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * 12 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, performing statistical analysis, and coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL).
**About the job** -----------------
Help serve Google's worldwide user base of more than a billion people. Data Scientists provide quantitative support, market understanding and a strategic perspective to our partners throughout the organization. As a data-loving member of the team, you serve as an analytics expert for your partners, using numbers to help them make better decisions. You will weave stories with meaningful insight from data. You'll make critical recommendations for your fellow Googlers in Engineering and Product Management. You relish tallying up the numbers one minute and communicating your findings to a team leader the next.
We are looking for a Staff Data Scientist to lead the technical evolution of our data systems across Google’s merchant and communication products. This role focuses on Business Agents, Google Business Profiles, and Business Messaging - surfaces that connect consumers with millions of businesses daily.
In this role, you will be expected to operate fluidly between data science and software engineering. You will not just run analyses; you will build the systems that perform them. We are moving away from manual SQL pulls and static dashboards. Your mandate is to build self-healing data pipelines, establish an AI-readable semantic layer, and develop autonomous agents capable of running full exploratory analyses.
Ultimately, your technical work must drive measurable business impact. You will bridge the gap between complex infrastructure and product execution - turning interaction data into clear, actionable insights that dictate what we build next. Your work will directly influence merchant Return on Investment (ROI), optimize consumer messaging funnels, and ensure our AI agents deliver tangible value to the businesses that rely on Google.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits
Learn more about benefits at Google.
**Responsibilities** --------------------
* Develop AI agents capable of executing end-to-end data analysis, from exploring interaction data in Business Profiles and writing queries, to diagnosing metric shifts and generating product recommendations. * Write and deploy production code to build data pipelines for Business Messaging and Business Agents. * Structure our data warehouses so they are universally readable by internal AI systems and product surfaces, ensuring accurate, reliable, and reproducible query retrieval. * Architect the statistical frameworks and infrastructure for A/B testing. Build automated systems that interpret experimental results, flag statistical noise, and output clear ship/no-ship recommendations. * Serve as a technical benchmark for the data organization. Write clean, maintainable code (Python, SQL), and mentor executive team members on system architecture and advanced statistical methods.

item.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Amazon Braket - Amazon Web Services
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Excited by the disruptive potential of quantum technology? Want to innovate on behalf of our customers to build quantum computing tools for the cloud? Thrilled to be key part of Amazon, who has been investing in disruptive innovation for decades, pioneering and shaping the world’s technology?
Amazon Braket is looking for Applied Scientists in quantum computing to join an exceptional team of researchers and engineers. Quantum computing is rapidly emerging from the realms of science-fiction, and our customers can the see the potential it has to address their challenges. One of our missions at AWS is to give customers access to the most innovative technology available and help them continuously reinvent their business. Quantum computing is a technology that holds promise to be transformational in many industries, and with Amazon Braket we are adding quantum computing resources to the toolkits of every researcher and developer.
As the technical lead for fault-tolerant quantum compilation, you'll own the full stack that transforms high-level quantum programs into optimized instructions that run on real hardware. You will play a key role in shaping the development roadmap of the service, and evangelizing new features and capabilities. Most importantly, you will work closely with our quantum computing research teams, as well as industry and academic partners. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to get drive innovation and deliver the right solutions to our customers.
A successful candidate will be a person who enjoys diving deep into customer problems, conducting independent research and development, working across teams with academic and industry experts, shaping the long-term QC strategy for AWS, and deliver the tools and systems that make useful quantum computing a reality for our customers. It will be a person who likes to have fun, loves to learn, and wants to innovate in the world of QC.
Key job responsibilities
* Own the technical vision and roadmap for the quantum compilation toolchain * Lead and grow a team of applied scientists and software engineers; set the bar for scientific rigor and engineering quality * Design compilation passes that minimize resource overhead for fault-tolerant quantum architectures * Collaborate with hardware, algorithms, and applications teams to co-design the compiler around real device constraints and customer workloads * Publish research and open-source contributions that advance the state of the art and attract world-class talent
About the team Amazon Braket is the quantum computing service by AWS. We give researchers, developer, and enterprises access to quantum hardware and the tools to build on it. Our goal is to make quantum computing a core part of the AWS accelerated compute portfolio.
The compilation team sits at the center of Braket's technical stack — bridging the gap between what customers write and what future fault-tolerant hardware executes. You'll work alongside hardware teams, scientists designing error correction protocols, and engineers building the service that bring these capabilities to our customers.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* 5+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience * Experience with leading experienced scientists as well as having a record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a career track in a business environment * Experience in more than one major programming language (C++, Java, or related) and at least one scripting language (Perl, Python, or equivalent) * Have peer-reviewed scientific contributions in premier journals and conferences * PhD in Quantum Computing, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related technical field
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience * Knowledge of problem solving, algorithm design and complexity analysis * Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment * Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs

* Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. * 8 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis. * Experience with Machine Learning research and developing new methodologies or algorithms. * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), or Generative AI. * Experience with Machine Learning algorithms and statistical modeling. * Experience with cyber threat research.
### **Preferred qualifications:**
* PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field. * 7 years of experience designing, validating, and deploying machine learning models, statistical methods, or generative AI systems into production. * 2 years of applied experience within cybersecurity, security operations, threat intelligence, fraud/abuse, or vulnerability research. * Experience acting as a Technical Lead, workstream owner, or principal researcher directing technical projects end-to-end across cross-functional teams. * Experience addressing distribution shifts, concept drift, or adversarial attacks in high-stakes or non-stationary environments. * Experience in production-grade development using programming languages and modern deep learning ecosystems.
**About the job** -----------------
The Google Cloud GUSTO AI Data Science Research team develops innovative, data-driven solutions to today’s most challenging cybersecurity problems. By leveraging data derived from Google's unparalleled view of the threat landscape, our cross-functional, applied research team experiments and delivers impactful findings for both our customers and the broader cybersecurity industry.
As a Staff Research Data Scientist (Tech Lead) you will define the technical goal, drive applied research agendas, and lead the technical execution of machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI initiatives across Google SecOps, Google Threat Intelligence, and other key cybersecurity product areas in Google Cloud.
In this role, you will manage high-ambiguity, adversarial security problems at Google scale. You will act as the principal research driver and technical lead across initiatives such as agentic security operations, threat intelligence reasoning and contextualization, security-specialized LLMs/foundation models, and dark web threat detection. As a Tech Lead, you will bridge the gap between breakthrough AI research and enterprise-grade deployment: architecting novel research prototypes, steering data strategy, aligning roadmaps with cross-functional SWE and Product leaders, and mentoring junior researchers. You will represent Google's security research externally through high-impact publications, patents, and conference presentations, shaping how the broader AI Security industry defends against advanced threat actors.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits
Learn more about benefits at Google.
**Responsibilities** --------------------
* Define and drive the multi-quarter research strategy and technical roadmap at the nexus of machine learning for security, AI-powered security operations, and autonomous threat investigation and response. * Serve as the Technical Lead (TL) for applied research workstreams, translating ambiguous threat challenges into structured, high-impact AI/ML modeling solutions with landed product impact. * Architect state-of-the-art model architectures and agentic systems, balancing theoretical novelty with low-latency, resilient inference in adversarial environments. * Architect end-to-end data acquisition and curation strategies across massive, heterogeneous security telemetry; establish benchmarks and evaluation pipelines for robust model assessment. * Partner with Engineering (SWE) and Product Management (PM) leadership to establish shared architectural roadmaps, govern production ML deployments, and lead continuous post-deployment telemetry and feedback loops.

item.title: Converge Signals, FSI - Data Scientist_Products & Platforms - Deloitte
item.description:
**The Team**
The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.
Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented **Data Scientist** to join the Converge for FSI team and help build differentiated, data-driven financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced analytics and financial services industry expertise, developing the models and insights that power Signals for FSI and future products in the Converge for FSI portfolio.
**Position Summary**
Financial services data holds enormous, often-underused potential - and turning it into decisions the business can act on takes both rigorous technical craft and real industry fluency. As a Data Scientist on the Signals for FSI team, you'll build the analytical engine behind one of Converge for FSI's flagship products, working hands-on with real financial services data to develop models clients can trust. You'll do it on a team that pairs start-up speed with the scale and credibility of Deloitte, giving you room to experiment while your work reaches some of the most influential institutions in financial services.
Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.
**Work you'll do**
As the Data Scientist, you will work at the intersection of data science, product, and financial services domain expertise to build and refine the models and analytics that power Signals for FSI:
* Develop, test, and refine statistical and machine learning models using financial services datasets (e.g., consumers, businesses, transactions, accounts, risk, or market data) to power Signals for FSI. * Partner with the Product team to translate financial services use cases into data requirements, features, data signals, and model specifications. * Conduct exploratory data analysis and validate data quality across structured and semi-structured financial services data sources. * Evaluate model performance against business and regulatory considerations relevant to financial services and iterate based on findings. * Translate analytical findings into clear, business-relevant insights for Product, Sales, and client-facing teams. * Stay current on emerging Statistical, AI/ML techniques and financial services data trends, and evaluate their application to the Signals for FSI roadmap.
The successful candidate would possess these skills:
* Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry, with curiosity about how data translates into real client outcomes - early use cases are retail banking, investment and wealth management and insurance, but will expand over time. * Strong analytical rigor paired with sound judgment about when a signal or model is ready to ship versus needing further refinement. * Comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and clear communication with product, engineering, and business stakeholders. * Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams at once. * Collaborative mindset and a willingness to partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring models into production. * Comfortable working through ambiguous, messy problems that require creativity and persistence.
**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. * 4+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, or statistical modeling, including hands-on model development and validation - proficient at using Python, SQL and other data transformation and analytical tools * Ability to travel 10-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
**Preferred:**

item.title: Senior Data Scientist - Abbott
item.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
**Working at Abbott**
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:
* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of. * Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year. * An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution * Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree. * A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune. * A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.
**About** **Lingo**
Meet Lingo, a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers – such as glucose, ketones, and lactate – to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize and democratize healthcare, enabling consumers to take control of their own health.
**The opportunity**
Personalized healthcare is the future. Working on Lingo, you will help build a next-generation technology that enables individuals to make decisions about how to improve energy, lose weight or enhance athletic performance. The Lingo team embodies a start-up culture and mindset with the backing of Abbott, a company with a rich history of healthcare innovation. Join us and grow your career as you help Abbott shape the future of healthcare.
You will apply your strong expertise in artificial intelligence by using machine learning to design, prototype, and build next-generation advanced analytics engines and services. You will work closely with software engineers, data architects, designers, and product owners and develop AI features, predictive models using machine learning and other advanced analytics tools to increase and optimize customer experience, revenue generation, prospect targeting, and other business outcomes.
This position works out of our **Alameda, CA** location in Lingo.
**What you’ll do**
* Work within an agile team in a dynamic, fast-moving, collaborative environment and design complex analytics models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions throughout the organization * Develop data and model pipelines with tools like Azure ML SDK, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Spark, or related technologies * Analyze large amounts of data to discover trends and patterns, and build analytics models * Ensure the highest level of data accessibility, security, and quality at all stages; create automated anomaly detection systems and monitor their performance and model drift * Effectively communicate complex ideas and results to both technical and business/executive audiences * Conduct advanced statistical and other analysis to provide actionable insights, identify trends, and measure performance * Create repeatable, interpretable, dynamic, and scalable models that are seamlessly incorporated into analytics data products * Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered conversational experiences, including chatbots and virtual assistants leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), intent classification, grounded responses, and policy-based controls.
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree, Advanced degree in computer science, biomedical, bioengineering, data science, or relevant, is preferred. * 8+ years of relevant experience in the data science/analytics space * Strong expertise in Python as well as proficiency in writing complex SQL queries * Proficiency in using machine learning to solve clustering, classification, regression, anomaly detection, simulation, and optimization problems on large-scale data sets
* Strong hands-on experience and expertise in one or more big data technologies, i.e., Hadoop, Spark, H20.ai, cloud AI platforms, containerization * Experience supporting deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement of analytics models * Experience building and deploying AI-powered conversational solutions, including intent classification, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounded response generation, policy and guardrail implementation, validation methodologies, and evaluation frameworks for production use cases. * Up to date on industry trends within the analytics space from a data acquisition processing, engineering, and management perspective * High level of curiosity, creativity, and problem-solving capabilities

item.title: Data Scientist III - Kaiser Permanente
item.description:
**Overview:**
The Risk Adjustment Data Management and Integrity team provides Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and ACA risk-related data to support key business initiatives. The ideal candidate has strong SQL and data transformation skills, experience managing large datasets, and a background in healthcare analytics or risk adjustment. Success in this role requires strong quality assurance, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
The Data Scientist III develops and applies advanced analytics, machine learning, and automation to improve risk adjustment data quality, throughput, and operational effectiveness. This role analyzes complex healthcare datasets, identifies data integrity issues and remediation opportunities, and develops predictive models and automated solutions to enhance the accuracy and completeness of risk adjustment submissions. Leveraging Python, SQL, Databricks, and machine learning technologies, the Data Scientist III helps drive the transition from rules-based analysis to predictive, intelligence-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate has experience with healthcare and risk adjustment data, predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and process optimization, along with strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
**Job Summary:**
This individual contributor is primarily responsible for participating in the design and development of data pipelines and automation for data acquisition and ingestion of raw data from multiple data sources and data formats under the guidance of more senior data scientists. This role is also responsible for developing detailed problem statements outlining hypotheses and their effect on target clients/customers, analyzing and investigating data sets and summarizing key characteristics, selecting, manipulating and transforming data into features used in machine learning algorithms, training statistical models under the guidance of more senior data scientists, deploying and maintaining reliable and efficient models through production, verifying model performance, and working with internal and external stakeholders across domains to develop and deliver statistical driven outcomes.

Listens to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; provides mentoring to team members. Pursues self-development; creates plans and takes action to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; influences others through technical explanations and examples. Supports, identifies, and monitors priorities, deadlines, and expectations. Identifies, speaks up, and implements ways to address improvement opportunities for team. * Develops detailed problem statements outlining hypotheses and their effect on target clients/customers by defining scope, objectives, outcome statements and metrics. * Participates in the design and development of data pipelines and automation for data acquisition and ingestion of raw data from multiple data sources and data formats under the guidance of more senior data scientists by transforming, cleansing, and storing data for consumption by downstream processes; writing and optimizing diverse SQL queries; and demonstrating a working knowledge of database fundamentals. * Analyzes and investigates data sets and summarizes key characteristics by employing data visualization methods; and determining how best to manipulate data sources to discover patterns, spot anomalies, test hypotheses, and/or check assumptions. * Selects, manipulates, and transforms data into features used in machine learning algorithms by leveraging techniques to conduct dimensionality reduction, feature importance, and feature selection. * Trains statistical models under the guidance of more senior data scientists by using algorithms and data mining techniques; testing models with various algorithms to assess the input dataset and related features; and applying techniques to prevent overfitting such as cross-validation. * Deploys and maintains reliable and efficient models through production. * Verifies model performance by demonstrating a working knowledge of a variety of model validation techniques to assess and discriminate the goodness of model fit; and leveraging feedback and output to manage and strengthen model performance. * Works with internal and external stakeholders across domains to develop and deliver statistical driven outcomes by delivering insights and values from heterogeneous data to investigate problems for multiple use cases; driving informed decision-making; and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Minimum one (1) year machine learning and/or algorithmic experience.

item.title: Senior Product Data Scientist - Ｃollective
item.description:
**About Collective:**
Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork.
Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures, QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft.
**About the role:**
We’re hiring a Senior Product Data Scientist to build and evolve the core product experiences that power Collective’s member platform. You’ll be the analytical voice in product strategy, working with product, engineering, Operations, Finance, and Go-to-Market to turn member behavior across incorporation, bookkeeping, tax, and payroll into clear insights that shape the roadmap. You’ll own the metrics and analysis behind key decisions end to end, from defining what we measure to making sure the underlying data holds up. This role directly shapes how we help self-employed members save time and money, and how we grow and retain them.
This is a hands-on role for someone who cares about data quality, takes ownership of production systems end-to-end, and wants their work to be the foundation the rest of the company builds on.
**What you'll do:**
* **Drive product strategy with stakeholders.** Work closely with product leads, engineering, Operations, Finance, and Go-to-Market. Share product insights regularly, shape the roadmap, and push back with evidence when the data says something different. * **Lead product analytics.** Approach problems from first principles and turn large, messy datasets into clear analysis and visuals that get to the "so what" and drive product insights across incorporation, bookkeeping, tax, and payroll. * **Use data science to uncover member behavior.** Apply statistical and modeling techniques such as segmentation, cohort, retention, and churn analysis to understand what members do, why they do it, and what it means for the product. * **Find and size growth.** Identify opportunities to grow membership and retention, size them, and help product leads prioritize what to build for the biggest long-term impact. * **Own the metrics.** Define, build, monitor, and report on the metrics behind product strategy and key initiatives, with one tested definition for each. * **Build the data you analyze.** Take raw sources (our product database, payments, support, and third-party tools) through Fivetran and dbt in BigQuery into clean, tested, documented datasets that the whole company can use. Fix problems at the source, not downstream. * **Keep it trustworthy.** Add tests, monitoring, and lineage so a number can be checked in minutes rather than believed on faith. * **Make the data agent-ready.** Maintain the definitions, semantic layer, and documentation that let Claude and our internal data agents answer questions correctly for anyone making a decision. * **Work with urgency and judgment.** Pick up ambiguous, open-ended questions with minimal direction, and deliver with attention to detail.
**What you'll bring:**
* **Experience:** 6+ years in data science, product analytics, analytics engineering, or data engineering, ideally at a B2B SaaS or fintech company. A bachelor's degree in mathematics, statistics, or a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * **An owner's mindset:** you are curious, keep asking "why" until you reach the bottom of a problem, and take initiative without waiting for a ticket. You take ambiguous, high-impact questions and see them through to a decision. * **Range across both sides:** you may be stronger in one, but you can do real work in the other. You can run an experiment analysis on Monday and fix a broken pipeline or model on Tuesday. * **SQL and Python (or R):** expert SQL and strong scripting for analysis, statistics, and tooling. * **Data engineering you have done yourself:** you have taken messy raw sources to trusted, tested datasets that other teams rely on, using a modern stack such as BigQuery, dbt, and Fivetran or similar. You know what good data looks like. * **Experimentation:** you design and interpret A/B and multivariate tests, understand power and guardrails, and build frameworks that turn results into launch decisions. Experience with Statsig, LaunchDarkly, or similar. * **Product analytics:** hands-on with Amplitude, Segment, Metabase, or similar. You turn complex datasets into actionable insights, and you can run exploratory analysis with minimal direction. * **Product sense:** you think through the detailed elements of a product experience and bring creative ideas for growth. * **Communication:** you tell clear, compelling stories with data and explain trade-offs to product leads and cross-functional partners.
**Nice to have:**

item.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Frontier AI Assets , Frontier AI Assets - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The Frontier AI Assets (FAI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Principal Applied Scientist with a strong deep learning and reinforcement learning background to build the training and evaluation assets that advance frontier Generative AI (GenAI) with Large Language Models (LLMs).
AI models become more capable largely because of the learning environments, the RL gyms, in which they are trained. FAI builds those gyms and the platform that certifies them, so that model training teams across Amazon can rely on high-quality, graded assets. As a Principal on this team, you will set the technical direction for how these gyms and the tooling around them are built, evaluated, and scaled.
Key job responsibilities As a Principal Applied Scientist with FAI, you will:
* Set technical direction across data collection, sampling, and evaluation for RL gyms focused on agentic tool use across a range of real-world domains. * Design and lead experiments that produce reliable, efficient signal on what drives model improvement. * Build gym-building tooling and automated quality control that scale with demand. * Advance the science of how gyms are evaluated and validated before they're used in model training. * Act as a hands-on technical leader: produce exemplary, high-quality assets yourself, and audit and support more junior scientists and engineers. * Partner closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams, turning real-world problems into challenging, high-value tasks. * Lead scientific reviews, scrutinize experimental design and verification, probe assumptions, and align teams toward coherent strategies. Contribute to hiring, mentorship, and the development of other scientists.
About the team The FAI team has the mission to push the envelope in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers. We build frontier training and evaluation assets, RL gyms and the certification platform behind them, that directly shape how Amazon's models are trained and improved. We value scientific depth, hands-on building, and turning research into measurable impact at scale.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; or Master's degree with significant additional applied research experience. * Strong hands-on experience building machine learning models and systems for real-world applications, with deep learning and neural methods. * Experience with reinforcement learning and/or building RL gyms, learning environments, or agentic tool-use systems. * Experience setting technical direction across data, modeling, and evaluation, and dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives. * Experience leading experienced scientists/engineers and developing more junior members.
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience * Experience building automated evaluation, quality-control, or verification tooling for training data or environments. * Experience with agentic tool use and improving the capabilities of LLMs (for example multi-step, tool-using agents). * Track record of creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art; peer-reviewed contributions in premier journals and conferences. * Experience with large-scale distributed training/compute and modern ML frameworks.
